IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
CIVIL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
INTERLOCUTORY APPLICATION NO.6 OF 2009
IN
CIVIL APPEAL NO.1390 OF 2007
SHRIPAL BHATI & ORS.
....Appellants
                      VERSUS
STATE OF U.P. & ORS.
....Respondents
O R D E R
By  filing  the  present  interlocutory application,  the  applicants/appellants  seek
permission to  withdraw their Civil Appeal No.1390/2007.   Permission sought for is
granted and the Civil Appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.  However, there will be no order
as to costs and interim order, if any, stands vacated.  I.A. is accordingly disposed of.
.....................J.
(TARUN CHATTERJEE)     
NEW DELHI,
JANUARY 21, 2009.
